name: generic electronic parking brake
source: [AS] Q3 / I8 (queue item, docs/next_steps_brief.md). An electronic parking brake on the car's own handbrake rows (brake_system.handbrake). max_engage_speed_mps 2.0 [AS]: 7.2 km/h, about walking pace - a production EPB applied above a few km/h either refuses or brakes dynamically; this model refuses (owner rule, verbatim: 'No, unless special modes are used (racing, drift), the parking brake should refuse to engage while speed is significant.'). epb_mode park_only by default; a drive_modes part overrides it per mode (car_hyper / car_hyper_n2o: handbrake in Racing).
